Body.Content:
Self-healing is an agentic feature that improves the resilience of desktop flows by recovering from UI or web automation failures. When an existing selector can no longer locate the intended UI element, Power Automate for desktop uses AI to identify the element and generate an alternative selector.

The preview phase includes an action-level opt-in option for automatically trying to recover from a selector error, while the GA phase will additionally include a flow-level opt-in option to only log the alternative, working selector in case of an error, without applying the fix during runtime.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: April CY2026
